_comment: Every local dev port, in one place (planning/agentic-engineering.md item 55). Agents never invent a port: tools/ci/check_ports.py fails on a localhost port not listed here. Ports that only appear in tests as invented values are under test_only.

ports.3100: web app under Playwright e2e and browser_check.py
ports.3002: web app for the open-air visual check (check-open-air.cjs)
ports.3300: web app for the mobile device fixture
ports.7244: Temporal dev server for session orchestration (tools/orchestrate, gRPC)
ports.8101: application API behind the web graph-viewer route

test_only.4321: invented unlisted port in test_ci_tools.py (proves the check fails)
